long_biography.plain_text:
Brad Title brought his experience with automotive customer-management software to Gubagoo, the dealership technology company he founded. An earlier venture had been sold to Cobalt. At Gubagoo, he focused on turning anonymous website visits into conversations, using shoppers' behaviour to time and tailor messages before a sales representative joined the exchange.

The platform has since broadened from chat to tools that connect customer data across a dealership. Title remained with Gubagoo when Reynolds and Reynolds acquired it and now serves as president. He continues to advocate using data to inform salespeople while keeping direct human contact within the buying process.
